facts.fact: On 2 May 2025 the Congolese regulator ARPTC granted a telecommunications network and services licence to Starlink DRC SA, allowing it to operate as an internet service provider (Starlink).

Starlink's conventional satellite broadband service, needing a dedicated terminal, became available in the DRC after the May 2025 licence; no launch date given, so dated to the article's publication date.
